notes: the first group is the report's chain: «محمد بن عبدالله ومحمد بن يحيى جميعا، عن عبدالله بن جعفر الحميري»; «اجتمعت أنا والشيخ أبوعمرو» is the teller's own account, and Abu Amr and Ahmad b. Ishaq are subjects of the story, not links
the second group is «وأخبرني أبوعلي أنه سأل ابا محمد عليه السلام»: a second route inside the matn, written as given with the Imam named in those words as the last link; ruling whether it is a route
«العمري» in the Imam's answer is a reference, not a link
the Mu'jam compiler is not a transmitter, so none is added
